dcterms:description: MAHNOB-HCI is a public multi-modal database that includes facial videos and corresponding ground truth heart rate signals recorded by Electrocardiography (ECG). The videos were recorded in realistic human-computer interaction scenarios with both illumination variations and subjects' motions involved.
dcterms:title: MAHNOB-HCI

dcterms:description: VideoHR is a simple database collected by the authors, consisting of videos recorded in a controlled environment without ambient illumination variations or body movement. It is used to demonstrate the accuracy of heart rate measurement methods.
dcterms:title: VideoHR
